name: @suluk/billing
description: Stripe PLUMBING over an injected config (secret key + a mockable fetch): the HTTP transport (with the refund idempotency-key), customer + SetupIntent + PaymentIntent creation, the saved-card surface (list/default/owns/set-default/detach + subscription card), and invoice retry. Pure Stripe wrappers — pricing, webhook dispatch, credit grants, email, and the subscription-plan logic stay in the app. Extracted from a real app (C046, v1: the clean transport + card surface). CANDIDATE tooling.
